page.overview:
Who is Berenicia Morsad?

Berenicia Morsad is an Aes Sedai of the Yellow Ajah. She is part of the Salidar Aes Sedai.

She is plump and always looks grave. She has a sharp tongue.

Berenicia is of high average strength in the One Power, with a strength level of of . She matches the stated minimum strength needed to be able to make a gateway of useful size. Barring some below average ability for the Talent, she should be able to Travel.

She is the second weakest in strength among the sisters making up the Salidar Embassy to the Dragon Reborn, with only Valinde Nathenos being weaker.
